tasks.title_zh: 建立经过复核的治理基线
acceptance: Reassess dated novelty evidence and environment report; preserve historical approval separately
Do not infer current novelty from the old note alone
acceptance_zh: 重新审阅带日期的查新证据和环境报告；单独保留历史批准记录
不能只靠旧记录推断当前的新颖性

tasks.title_en: Recover and verify external validation cohorts
tasks.title_zh: 获取并核实外部验证队列
acceptance: Verify official mirror accessions, file integrity and provenance before analysis
Map actual clinical fields and endpoints; preserve download failures; update verified flags only after QC
acceptance_zh: 分析前核实官方镜像的登录号、文件完整性和来源
映射真实临床字段与终点；保留下载失败记录，质控后才更新 verified

acceptance: Freeze module gene lists, scoring, splits and sensitivity analyses in config before seeing outcomes
Do not infer CXCR3 isoforms from gene-level assays that cannot distinguish them
acceptance_zh: 看结局前在配置中冻结模块基因、评分、数据拆分和敏感性分析
不能从无法区分亚型的基因水平检测推断 CXCR3 亚型

acceptance: Evaluate actual eligible independent cohorts using prespecified config
Report negative and discordant evidence; a pending second cohort cannot count as validation
acceptance_zh: 按预设配置评估实际符合条件的独立队列
报告阴性与方向不一致结果；待获取的第二队列不能算验证

tasks.title_en: Build and check the compartment atlas
tasks.title_zh: 构建并核查单细胞区室图谱
acceptance: Implement missing pipeline rule and reproducible cell QC/annotation
Assess donor-level support, malignant-cell uncertainty and frozen module definitions
acceptance_zh: 实现缺少的流水线规则及可复现的细胞质控和注释
检查供者层面支持、恶性细胞识别不确定性和已冻结模块

acceptance: Prespecify tests, correction and effect-size reporting
Treat association as association and report all planned comparisons
acceptance_zh: 预设检验、多重校正和效应量报告
按关联证据表述，报告全部预定比较

tasks.title_zh: 实现免疫治疗迁移验证
acceptance: Keep non-osteosarcoma transfer evidence explicitly indirect
Record missing packages/data as blockers, not empty successful outputs
acceptance_zh: 明确非骨肉瘤迁移证据的间接性质
缺少软件包或数据就记录阻塞，不能用空产物冒充成功

acceptance: Feature selection and tuning inside nested CV; preserve independent external holdout
Review discrimination uncertainty, calibration and prespecified acceptance criteria
acceptance_zh: 特征筛选和调参纳入嵌套交叉验证；保留独立外部留出集
检查区分度不确定性、校准和预定验收条件

acceptance: Trace figure values to statistics; assess layout and biological labels
A generated design diagram is not a validated result figure
acceptance_zh: 图中数值追溯至统计登记；检查布局和生物学标签
研究设计示意图不等于已验证结果图

tasks.title_en: Implement and verify the local atlas
acceptance: Test real modules at desktop and phone widths; expose data provenance
Local verification does not authorize public deployment
acceptance_zh: 在桌面与手机宽度测试真实模块并展示数据来源
本地验收不构成公开部署授权

tasks.title_zh: 审计稿件并解决审稿意见
acceptance: Resolve every statistic placeholder from validated registry; report audit exit code
Resolve reviewer concerns; disclose exploratory/indirect evidence and actual AI usage
acceptance_zh: 用经过校验的登记表解析全部统计占位符，报告审计退出码
解决审稿意见；披露探索性、间接证据及实际 AI 使用
